kb_data.book_title_or_topic: Brihatparāśarahorāśāstra (Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra) - Comprehensive Classical Vedic Astrology (Jyotish)
structural_outline: Cosmology, Creation, and Divine Incarnations of Grahas (Chapters 1-2)
Astronomical Foundations: Grahas, 27 Nakshatras, 12 Rāśis, and Special Lagnas (Chapters 3-5)
Divisional Schemes: The Sixteen Vargas (Shodashavargas) and Divisional Considerations (Chapters 6-7)
Judgement of the Twelve Bhavas and Effects of Bhava Lords (Chapters 11-24)
Secondary Planets (Upagrahas) and Subtle Points: Dhum, Vyatipat, Paridhi, Chap, Sikhi, Gulika, and Pranapad (Chapter 25)
Evaluation of Drishti Strengths, Shadbala, and Isht/Kasht Balas (Chapters 26-28)
Arudhas, Padas, Upa Padas, and Argala Systems (Chapters 29-31)
Significators (Karakatwas: Char and Sthir Karakas) and Karakāńśa Analysis (Chapters 32-33)
Planetary Yogas: Yoga Karakas, Nabhasha Yogas, Chandra/Surya Yogas, Raja Yogas, Wealth, and Penury (Chapters 34-42)
Longevity Calculations (Pindayu, Nisargayu, Ańśayu) and Maraka Grahas/Bhavas (Chapters 43-44)
Avasthas of Grahas: Baaladi, Deeptadi, and Shayanadi Avasthas (Chapter 45)
Dasha Systems: Nakshatra Dashas (Vimshottari, Ashtottari, etc.) and Rasi Dashas (Char, Sthir, Kaal Chakr) (Chapters 46-65)
Ashtakavarga System: Rekha/Bindu, Trikona Shodhana, Ekadhipatya Shodhana, and Pinda Sadhana (Chapters 66-72)
Planetary Rays (Rasmis) and the Sudarshana Chakra System (Chapters 73-74)
Specialized Astrology: Panchamahapurusha Yogas, Five Elements, Gunas, Lost Horoscopy, and Female Horoscopy (Chapters 75-80)
Samudrika Shastra: Physical Features, Body Marks, and Moles (Chapters 81-82)
Karmic Curses from Previous Births, Inauspicious Births, and Vedic Remedial Rituals (Chapters 83-97)
visual_diagrams_found: Drishti Chakra Diagram: Square or circular 8-direction diagram illustrating planetary aspect angles and geometric ray alignments
Ashtakavarga Prastara Table: A 117-compartment matrix (14 horizontal lines by 10 vertical columns) for mapping Rekhas and Bindus across eight reference points
Sudarshana Chakra Diagram: Concentric tri-circle chart containing 12 houses each for Lagna, Chandra, and Surya
Kaal Chakra Kundalis: Savya and Apsavya 12-apartment (Kostha) grid layouts for Nakshatra Pada progression
Janma, Bhava, and Navamsha Kundali structural representations referenced for planetary positions and padas
foundational_principles: Tripartite division of Vedic Astrology (Jyotish Vedanga): Hora (predictive/horoscopy), Ganita (mathematical astronomy), and Samhita (mundane/omens)

Macrocosm-Microcosm correspondence: The Twelve Rasis represent the physical limbs of Kala Purusha (Time personified), with human destiny mediated by planetary incarnations (Paramatmamsha and Jivatmamsha)

Bhava Classification: Kendras (quadrants: 1, 4, 7, 10 - Vishnu Sthanas), Konas/Trikonas (trines: 1, 5, 9 - Lakshmi Sthanas), Panapharas (succedents: 2, 5, 8, 11), Apoklimas (cadents: 3, 6, 9, 12), Upachayas (growth houses: 3, 6, 10, 11), and Dusthanas/Trikas (malefic houses: 6, 8, 12)

Shodashavargas: Sixteen divisional subdivisions of the zodiacal arc (Rasi, Hora, Dreshkan, Chaturthamsa, Saptamsa, Navamsa, Dashamsa, Dvadashamsa, Shodashamsa, Vimsamsa, Chaturvimsamsa, Saptavimsamsa, Trimsamsa, Khavedamsa, Akshavedamsa, Shashtiamsa) revealing distinct life dimensions

Shadbala Assessment: Evaluation of planetary potency via six primary metrics: Sthana Bala (positional), Dig Bala (directional), Kaal Bala (temporal), Cheshta Bala (motional), Naisargika Bala (inherent), and Drik Bala (aspectual)

Argala and Virodhargala: Principles of intervention and obstruction, wherein planets in the 2nd, 4th, 11th (and 5th) exert energetic intervention counteracted by planets in the 12th, 10th, 3rd (and 9th)
Jaimini/Parashari Synthesis: Application of Char Karakas (Atmakaraka to Darakaraka based on longitudinal degrees) alongside Arudha/Bhava Padas and Upa Padas

Multi-Tiered Timing: Nakshatra-based predictive systems led by the 120-year Vimshottari cycle down to Antar, Pratyantar, Sukshma, and Prana levels, cross-referenced with Kaal Chakra, Chara, and transit Ashtakavarga
